lines: University of Queensland Peter Whiteman Memorial Bursary 2020
Follow this page to get timely alerts on

The University of Queensland, Australia invites applications for the University of Queensland Peter Whiteman Memorial Bursary 2020 from students enrolled in postgraduate (higher degree by research) programme. The aim of this scholarship is to provide bursaries to assist the research or professional development of post-graduate students enrolled at The University of Queensland who are studying in the field of tropical agronomy. Selected students will get annual income from the endowment.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
Be currently enrolled in a postgraduate program at The University of Queensland
Provide a plan indicating how the Bursary would be spent in furthering the applicant’s research or professional development in the field of tropical agronomy
The selected scholars will receive annual income from the endowment.
Follow the steps below to apply for the bursary:
Selection will be based on academic achievement, personal qualities, plan and other relevant details submitted by the applicants.
The bursary is tenable for one year.
Recipients of the bursary will have to continue to be enrolled full-time in the program, and maintain satisfactory academic progress.
One scholarship may be awarded annually by Senate on the recommendation of the Associate Dean (Academic) after consultation with the Head, School of Agriculture and Food Sciences.
The value of the scholarship is the annual income from the fund.
School of Agriculture and Food Sciences
